'''Corthel''' was a gas that had light-reflecting properties. Settlers on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]] in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]] discovered Corthel on [[Nurstin]], one of the other planets in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], when they noticed unusual flashes of light emanating from the surface and investigated. It had a corresponding rock form known as [[Cortheum]].<ref name="GK" />
